PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 9, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54007  Recommendation to approve December 19, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54008  Recommendation to approve contribution in the amount of $10,000 for the City of
  Long Beach State of the City Address to be held on Tuesday, January 14, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-54009  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1528 authorizing the General Manager to
  execute an agreement and any amendments with InPipe Energy Inc., to provide
  predevelopment services for an energy recovery project, in an amount not to
  exceed $110,500.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-54015  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
 three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

 ANNOUNCEMENTS

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than
 72 hours prior to the meeting.

PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 9, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naiomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 President Maguire called the meeting to order at 9:00 AM.

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Dynna Long led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Rainey, Shannon, Cordero, Scott, Maguire

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54007  Recommendation to approve December 19, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Rainey, seconded by Commissioner
  Shannon, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Rainey, Shannon, Cordero, Scott, Maguire
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

 2.  25-54008  Recommendation to approve contribution in the amount of $10,000 for the City of
  Long Beach State of the City Address to be held on Tuesday, January 14, 2025.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, provided the staff report.
  Secretary Cordero spoke.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Shannon, seconded by Secretary
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Dr. Yan Zhang, Senior Director of Water Quality and Process, provided the staff
  report.

  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney, spoke.
  Secretary Cordero spoke.
  Vice President Scott spoke.
  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

4.  25-54015  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, provided the staff report.
  Secretary Cordero spoke.
  Anatole Falagan spoke.
  Commissioner Shannon spoke.
  Anatole Falagan spoke.
  Dean Wang, Director of Resources, spoke.
  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Cordero, Anatole Falagan, and Dean Wang.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Shannon, seconded by Secretary
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following

  Yes:  5  Rainey, Shannon, Cordero, Scott, Maguire

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Commissioner Shannon acknowledged Commissioner Rainey for her service over the years with the
NAACP, and he requested that the Board adjourn the January 9, 2025 meeting in honor of

 A dialogue ensued between Anatole Falagan and Commissioner Shannon.
 President Maguire spoke.
 Anatole Falagan spoke.
 President Maguire spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

President Maguire adjourned the meeting at 9:48 AM.
